data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Careers → Openings → Country/Team/Time Type filters → Search → open a job) with the right order and the three filter parameters, but it omits the action parameter (open or apply/save), adds an unneeded "keywords/location" parameter, and doesn't name the job to open as a parameter, so it is a little short of fully automatable.
